title: Large-scale transcript variants dictate neoepitopes for cancer immunotherapy.
summary: AI-guided transcript-variant analysis identifies large-scale transcript variants that encode tumor neoepitopes relevant to cancer immunotherapy.
ai_technology: The study combines ribosome-nascent-chain transcript sequencing and predictive models, then reports experimental validation of selected neoepitopes/immunogenicity.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: AI-guided transcript-variant analysis identifies large-scale transcript variants that encode tumor neoepitopes relevant to cancer immunotherapy.
evidence.unknown: The reported transcript-variant and neoepitope findings do not by themselves establish patient response to immunotherapy or clinical benefit.
